title: Transportability from Boston: irrelevant car ownership
content: Figure 10.2(c) adds Car Ownership V, caused by Age Z, and selector S -> V. Because V affects neither treatment X nor outcome Y, the advertising effect transports directly from Boston to Arkansas.

variables.name: Purchase Decision (Y)
variables.content: Whether the consumer purchases the product.

variables.name: Age (Z)
variables.content: Age, a confounder of advertisement and purchase.

variables.name: Click-through Rate (W)
variables.content: The mediator between advertisement and purchase.

variables.name: Car Ownership (V)
variables.content: A population characteristic irrelevant to Advertisement X and Purchase Y.

variables.name: Population Difference (S)
variables.content: The difference-producing selector for Boston car ownership.

arrows.because: Figure 10.2(c) draws Age as a cause of Car Ownership.
Figure 10.2(c) points selector S to Car Ownership V.
